command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
echo '== cut the first 200,000 pairs out of the same reads the full run used =='
# 200000 pairs = 800000 lines. awk, not head: head closes the pipe early and SIGPIPEs zcat,
# which under pipefail kills the task.
zcat ERR188026_1.fastq.gz | awk 'NR<=800000' | gzip -1 > sub_1.fq.gz
zcat ERR188026_2.fastq.gz | awk 'NR<=800000' | gzip -1 > sub_2.fq.gz
kallisto quant -i kallisto.idx -o out -t 16 sub_1.fq.gz sub_2.fq.gz 2> q.log
cp out/abundance.tsv abundance_sub.tsv
cp out/run_info.json run_info.json
N=$(awk -F'[:,]' '/n_processed/{gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",$2);print $2;exit}' run_info.json)
echo "fragments $N"
test "$N" -eq 200000
echo 'SUBSET KALLISTO OK'
